units.source_text: 无论是名人还是七段，都属长考型。

en.t: Both the Master and the seventh dan were the type to think for a long time.

units.source_text: 七段的棋，一般都要等规定时间快到，剩下一分钟才以下百手的气势逼将过去，这倒是惊人的。

en.t: The seventh dan usually waited until the allotted time was almost gone, then with only one minute left pressed on with the force of playing more than a hundred moves, which was truly astonishing.

units.source_text: 但是，名人不是在时间制的束缚下培养出来的，不可能表演这种惊险的技艺。

en.t: But the Master had not been trained under the constraints of timed play, and could not display this kind of perilous skill.

units.source_text: 也许他本来就盼望在一生决定最后胜负的这盘棋中，能不受时间限制尽情地下，这才规定四十个小时吧。

en.t: Perhaps from the start he had hoped that in this game, which would decide the final victory or defeat of his life, he could play to his heart's content without being bound by time, and that was why forty hours had been set.
